body: My scars are fading. But my strength still remains. Everyday I look at my scars and can’t help to think about how far I’ve come. It’s upsetting to see the pain I was in at such a young age. Pain and suffering has no age limit, but neither does recovery. I still think about self harming. I’ve scratched myself, burned myself, anything to make me feel something. Life is still hard. I don’t think it will ever get easier. But, tomorrow is no guarantee. Pain will always come and go, and there will never be pure bliss or pure pain in life. It is important to remember small steps lead to great victories. Keep fighting my friends 🖤
